note: Three-year average of total reinvestment over revenue (14.2% in 2023, 18.8% in 2024, 16.4% in 2025). Reinvestment here is property and equipment, intangibles, equipment for joint revenue sharing arrangements, and film assets, all from the 10-K cash flow statement.
